pages.title: About Aytal Mart
pages.html:
Thoughtful Products. Meaningful Moments.

Aytal Mart was founded on 22 September 2026 by M-Afzaal and Talha Ahmad with a simple idea: to create thoughtfully designed products that bring beauty, usefulness and meaning into everyday spaces.

We are a Lahore-based brand focused on creating and offering carefully designed products for prayer, gifting and the home.

Our approach is simple: we pay attention to the product from its design and materials to its finishing, quality inspection and packaging.

Built With Attention to Detail

Our products are developed with a focus on thoughtful design and practical everyday use.

For our AYTAL Quran and Janamaz Stand, the process begins with a detailed AutoCAD design. The design is then transferred to iron sheet for CNC laser cutting, followed by bending, assembly, welding where required, grinding and double powder coating.

Before dispatch, every finished product is manually inspected to check its overall finish and condition.

Made With Care in Lahore

Our current operations are based in Ittehad Colony, Lahore, Pakistan.

For the AYTAL Quran and Janamaz Stand, iron sheet is sourced from the Misri Shah market in Lahore, while CNC work is carried out in Loha Market, Naulakha, Lahore.

We work through each stage with attention to detail, from the initial design to the final packaged product.

Packed for the Journey

Once a product passes quality inspection, we carefully prepare it for shipment.

The product is first wrapped in stretch film, then protected with bubble wrap, and finally placed inside a 5-ply corrugated box.

Orders are shipped using courier services such as TCS, Leopards and PostEx, depending on the shipment.

Our Promise

We aim to make every part of the customer experience straightforward — from discovering a product and placing an order to receiving it at home.

Aytal Mart is at the beginning of its journey, and we are building the brand one thoughtfully made product at a time.

Aytal Mart

Founded: 22 September 2026
Founders: M-Afzaal & Talha Ahmad
Based in: Lahore, Pakistan

pages.title: Return & Exchange Policy
pages.html:
At Aytal Mart, we want you to be happy with your purchase. If you receive a wrong, damaged, or defective product, you may request a return or exchange according to the policy below.

1. Return & Exchange Window

You may request a return or exchange within 7 days of receiving your order.

The request must be submitted within this period. Requests made after 7 days may not be accepted.

2. Damaged During Transit

If your parcel arrives damaged, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery.

To help us review the issue quickly, please provide clear photos or a video showing:

  • The outer packaging
  • The damaged area
  • The product after opening

This helps us verify whether the damage occurred during transit.

3. Eligible Reasons for Return or Exchange

You may contact us within 7 days if you receive:

Wrong Product
A different product from the one ordered.

Manufacturing Defect
A product with a manufacturing-related defect.

Color Issue
Significant damage or issue with the product's color.

Metal/Product Damage
Significant damage to the product that was not caused by customer use.

After reviewing the claim, we may offer a replacement or refund, subject to inspection and verification.

4. Product Condition

For a standard return or exchange, the product should be:

  • Unused
  • In its original condition
  • Returned with its original packaging where applicable

Products showing damage caused by misuse, accidental damage, or normal wear and tear are not eligible for return or exchange.

5. Return Shipping Charges

For a standard return, the customer is responsible for return shipping costs.

For an eligible exchange involving a wrong, damaged, or defective product, Aytal Mart will bear the applicable shipping cost.

6. Inspection & Approval

Once we receive the returned product, our team will inspect it.

A replacement or refund will be processed only after the claim has been reviewed and approved according to this policy.

7. Refund

Where a refund is approved, the refund will be processed through the applicable method available for the order.

The timing of the refund may depend on the payment method and processing arrangements.

8. Items Not Covered

Returns or exchanges are not applicable for:

  • Damage caused by misuse or accidents
  • Normal wear and tear
  • Products altered or damaged after delivery by the customer
  • Requests submitted outside the applicable return period

9. How to Request a Return or Exchange

To request a return or exchange, contact our support team with:

Order Number
Customer Name
Phone Number
Reason for Return/Exchange
Clear Photos or Video, where applicable

Contact Us

Email:support@aytalmart.com

Our support team is available 24/7.

pages.title: Care & Installation Guide
pages.html:
Keep Your Aytal Stand Looking Its Best

Your Aytal Quran & Janamaz Stand is designed for everyday use with a durable powder-coated metal finish. Proper installation and simple care can help maintain its appearance and functionality.

1. Installation

The product is supplied with:

7 Screws
7 Wall Plugs

Choose a suitable, solid wall surface before installation.

Mark the required fixing points carefully and use appropriate tools to secure the stand firmly to the wall.

Make sure all screws are properly tightened before placing any items on the stand.

Installation service is not currently provided by Aytal Mart.

2. Cleaning

To clean your stand:

Use a soft, dry or slightly damp cloth.

Gently wipe away dust and surface dirt.

After cleaning with a damp cloth, wipe the surface dry.

Avoid harsh cleaning chemicals, abrasive materials, or rough scrubbing that may affect the finish.

3. Protecting the Finish

The stand has a powder-coated finish.

To help maintain its appearance:

Keep the product away from unnecessary moisture.

Avoid prolonged exposure to water.

Do not use steel wool, abrasive pads, or strong chemicals on the surface.

Clean spills or moisture promptly.

4. Everyday Use

Place the product securely on the wall before regular use.

Avoid placing excessive weight on the stand beyond what it is designed to hold.

Use the Quran and Janamaz holders for their intended purposes and handle the product carefully.

5. Important Safety Note

Before installation, check that the selected wall surface is suitable for the supplied wall plugs and screws.

For walls requiring specialized anchors or fixing methods, use an appropriate hardware solution suitable for that wall type.

If you are unsure about installation, consider getting assistance from a qualified installer.

6. Product Care

With proper care, your Aytal stand can maintain its finish and appearance for longer.

Regular dusting, gentle cleaning, and keeping the product away from unnecessary moisture are recommended.

Need Help?

For product or installation-related questions, contact us:

Email:support@aytalmart.com

Our support team is available 24/7.

products.html:
A Thoughtfully Designed Prayer Space Essential

Keep your Quran and Janamaz beautifully organized with the AYTAL Quran and Janamaz Stand — a thoughtfully designed metal wall organizer created for a clean, practical and peaceful prayer space.

Made from 1mm iron sheet, each piece is precision cut, shaped, finished and manually quality checked before being carefully packed for delivery.

The set includes a dedicated Quran holder, Janamaz holder and 5 Tasbeeh hooks, giving you an organized place for your essential prayer items while keeping your space neat and elegant.

Designed for Everyday Use

The Quran holder is carefully shaped to securely accommodate your Quran, while the dedicated Janamaz stand provides a convenient place to hang your prayer mat.

The Quran stand features a practical interlocking construction, while the Janamaz stand is bent and side-welded for stability. The finished product is ground smooth and coated with a double powder-coating process.

Made With Care

The journey begins with iron sheets sourced from the steel market in Misri Shah, Lahore. The product design is prepared in AutoCAD, followed by CNC laser cutting in Loha Market, Naulakha, Lahore.

The components are then bent, assembled and welded where required, followed by grinding, double powder coating and a final manual quality inspection.

Each order is protected using stretch film and bubble wrap before being placed inside a 5-ply corrugated box for secure delivery.
